title: AFCI-Bench v2 Evaluator Manifest (frozen, external)
description: The frozen, externally mounted manifest that tells the architecture-conformance oracle what to evaluate for one task: applicable rule ids, the FROZEN fixed opportunity set (the applicable-opportunity denominator), required/optional/prohibited areas, legitimate-alternative references, manual-rubric and hidden-test references, a checkpoint reference, evaluator content hashes, invalidation status, and the frozen dependency policy the reference checker applies. It is mounted OUTSIDE the coding worktree (see EVALUATOR_MOUNT_POLICY.md). Development scaffolding for study v2: committed instances are templates/synthetic and MUST carry no task-specific answers (answers_populated=false). No paid run produced it.

task_id.description: Task identifier placeholder. Null or a TASK-TEMPLATE-* id in committed templates; a real task id only in externally mounted, private manifests.

status.description: Lifecycle state. The oracle scores ONLY a manifest whose status is exactly 'frozen' and whose invalidation.invalidated is false; every other state fails closed (enforced by the engine, not merely this schema).

opportunities.description: The FROZEN fixed opportunity set. Its size is the applicable-opportunity denominator; it is frozen per task manifest and NOT derived from how many files/layers a model touched. Each opportunity locates where a rule applies; it carries no expected implementation answer. opportunity_id MUST be unique across this array — JSON Schema cannot express object-property uniqueness, so the oracle loader is the authoritative guard and fails closed (DUPLICATE_OPPORTUNITY_ID) on any repeat; uniqueItems here is a weaker backstop that only catches fully-identical entries.

locator.description: Where the rule applies. Structural only (importer path/scope and forbidden target layers); never an implementation answer.

areas.description: Structural surface areas as path globs. Required/optional/prohibited AREAS (not answers): which parts of the tree the task may touch. Kept out of the coding worktree.

legitimate_alternatives.description: References to accepted legitimate-alternative solution shapes (frozen before confirmatory data). Empty in committed templates (no answers).

evaluator_hashes.description: Map of mounted evaluator file path -> SHA-256, recorded so the run manifest can prove provenance without exposing contents.

dependency_policy.description: Frozen policy the dependency-direction reference checker applies. Repository-architecture-level (same across tasks on a base SHA); NOT a task answer. Layers are assigned by frozen path globs so a model cannot relabel a file by editing tsconfig.

alias_config_path.description: Path, relative to the snapshot root, of the tsconfig whose compilerOptions.paths/baseUrl drive alias resolution.

allowed.description: Map of layer id -> array of allowed target layer ids. Intra-layer and third-party imports are always allowed.

answers_populated.description: MUST be false for any manifest committed to the public repository: committed manifests are templates/synthetic and carry no task-specific answers.
